text: EduQuery College offers a 4-year B.Tech Computer Science program covering full-stack development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data structures, algorithms, and cybersecurity with industry-led projects.
The BBA Business Analytics program is a 3-year undergraduate course focused on market trends, data-driven decision making, statistics, visualization, and organizational growth.
B.Tech Civil Engineering is a 4-year program in sustainable infrastructure, modern urban planning, structural design, and construction management.
B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) is a 4-year program covering VLSI, embedded systems, communication networks, and IoT.
The MCA program is a 2-year postgraduate course in software engineering, databases, cloud computing, and applied AI for graduates from computing or related backgrounds.
MBA at EduQuery College is a 2-year postgraduate program with specializations in Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, and Business Analytics.
B.Sc Data Science is a 3-year program covering Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, and applied analytics projects.
Undergraduate engineering admission requires Class 12 (PCM) with a minimum of 60% in core subjects, plus qualification in the National Entrance Test (NET) or the University Merit Exam held in May.
Management and analytics undergraduate programs require Class 12 in any stream with at least 55% aggregate. Mathematics at Class 12 is preferred for Business Analytics and Data Science.
MBA admission requires a bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate and a valid CAT, MAT, or University Aptitude Test score, followed by a counseling interview.
MCA admission requires a bachelor's degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level and a minimum of 50% marks.
The primary undergraduate application window closes on July 15 every year. Early applications submitted by March are considered for scholarship eligibility.
IB, Cambridge, and other international boards are accepted. Students should submit predicted grades and an equivalence certificate during counseling.
The admission process has three steps: academic eligibility check, entrance examination, and a counseling session to map student goals to the curriculum.
Annual tuition for B.Tech programs is INR 1,60,000. Hostel charges are INR 80,000 per year including meals. A one-time registration fee of INR 10,000 is payable at admission.
Annual tuition for BBA and B.Sc Data Science is INR 1,20,000. MBA annual tuition is INR 2,40,000. MCA annual tuition is INR 1,50,000.
Merit scholarships of 25% to 50% tuition waiver are available for students scoring above 90% in Class 12 or ranking in the top 5% of the entrance exam.
Need-based financial aid and education loan assistance letters are provided through the admissions office after fee assessment.
The overall placement rate at EduQuery College is 92% for eligible final-year students in the latest academic year.
The average placement package is 6 LPA and the highest package offered is 18 LPA.
Computer Science students recorded an average package of 7.5 LPA with a highest offer of 18 LPA in software, AI, and product roles.
Top recruiters include Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Amazon, Deloitte, Capgemini, and HDFC Bank.
The Training and Placement Cell runs aptitude training, mock interviews, resume workshops, and internship drives from the fifth semester onward.
Paid internships are available from the sixth semester. Typical internship stipends range from INR 10,000 to INR 40,000 per month.
The campus library is open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays and provides digital journals, IEEE access, and quiet study zones.
Student hostel facilities include Wi-Fi, a mess, gym, medical room, and 24x7 security. First-year undergraduates are given priority for on-campus housing.
The academic year typically starts in August. Odd semester exams are in December and even semester exams are in May.

The help desk can answer questions about courses, admissions, fees, scholarships, placements, internships, hostel, and campus facilities. For documents and official letters, contact the registrar at registrar@eduquery.edu.
